t: 马萨诸塞州殖民地发行了美洲第一张纸币。
te: The colony of Massachusetts issues the first paper money in the Americas.
dz: 马萨诸塞州殖民地发行了美洲第一张纸币。
de: The colony of Massachusetts issues the first paper money in the Americas.

t: 摩尔达维亚亲王康斯坦丁·坎特米尔和神圣罗马帝国在西比乌签订秘密条约,规定摩尔达维亚会支持哈布斯…
te: Constantin Cantemir, Prince of Moldavia, and the Holy Roman Empire sign a secret treaty in Sibiu, stipulating that Mold…
dz: 摩尔达维亚亲王康斯坦丁·坎特米尔和神圣罗马帝国在西比乌签订秘密条约,规定摩尔达维亚会支持哈布斯堡王室所领导的反对奥斯曼帝国的行动.
de: Constantin Cantemir, Prince of Moldavia, and the Holy Roman Empire sign a secret treaty in Sibiu, stipulating that Moldavia would support the actions led by the House of Habsburg against the Ottoman Empire.

t: 英格兰国王威廉三世(英语:William of Orange)在爱尔兰登陆以对抗前国王詹姆斯二…
te: King William III of England (William of Orange) lands in Ireland to confront the former King James II.
dz: 英格兰国王威廉三世(英语:William of Orange)在爱尔兰登陆以对抗前国王詹姆斯二世.
de: King William III of England (William of Orange) lands in Ireland to confront the former King James II.

t: 卢森堡元帅在弗勒鲁斯战役中战胜英荷军队。
te: Marshal de Luxembourg triumphs over an Anglo-Dutch army at the battle of Fleurus.
dz: 大联盟之战：卢森堡元帅在弗勒鲁斯战役中战胜英荷军队。
de: War of the Grand Alliance: Marshal de Luxembourg triumphs over an Anglo-Dutch army at the battle of Fleurus.

t: 爱尔兰博因河之战（按照儒略历计算）。
te: Battle of the Boyne in Ireland (as reckoned under the Julian calendar).
dz: 光荣革命：爱尔兰博因河之战（按照儒略历计算）。
de: Glorious Revolution: Battle of the Boyne in Ireland (as reckoned under the Julian calendar).

t: 安妮·希拉里昂·德·图维尔 (Anne Hilarion de Tourville) 率领的法…
te: French naval forces led by Anne Hilarion de Tourville, fresh from their victory at Beachy Head, sail West and launch a …
dz: 九年战争：安妮·希拉里昂·德·图维尔 (Anne Hilarion de Tourville) 率领的法国海军刚刚在比奇角 (Beachy Head) 取得胜利后，向西航行，对英国小镇廷茅斯 (Teignmouth) 发动袭击，使其满目疮痍。
de: Nine Years' War: French naval forces led by Anne Hilarion de Tourville, fresh from their victory at Beachy Head, sail West and launch a raid on the small English town of Teignmouth, leaving it devastated.

t: 东印度公司的乔布·查诺克(Job Charnock)在加尔各答建立了一个工厂,这个活动以前被认…
te: Job Charnock of the East India Company establishes a factory in Calcutta, an event formerly considered the founding of …
dz: 东印度公司的乔布·查诺克(Job Charnock)在加尔各答建立了一个工厂,这个活动以前被认为是该市的创立(2003年加尔各答高等法院裁定该市的奠基日期不详).
de: Job Charnock of the East India Company establishes a factory in Calcutta, an event formerly considered the founding of the city (in 2003 the Calcutta High Court ruled that the city's foundation date is unknown).

t: 福雷因克和内克出版社(Public Occurrences Both Forreign and…
te: Publick Occurrences Both Forreign and Domestick, the first newspaper to appear in the Americas, is published for the fi…
dz: 福雷因克和内克出版社(Public Occurrences Both Forreign and Internalk)是第一家在美洲出名的报纸,第一次也是唯一的一次出版.
de: Publick Occurrences Both Forreign and Domestick, the first newspaper to appear in the Americas, is published for the first and only time.
